params.caption: 🎮 Palworld studio gives staff a "business trip to Vice City" for GTA 6 launch Pocketpair says all employees who plan to play GTA 6 get special leave from November 19 to 23, which includes a weekend. The studio says Palworld and Craftopia updates will still arrive on schedule. Logitech, Burger Motorsports and Edison Motors are also giving staff time off for the launch. 🕒 Nov 13, 2026 · 01:08 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer 👥 @Palworld_EN · @RockstarGames 🌴 React if your boss should do this too · 💬 Taking time off for GTA 6? #GTA6 #Palworld #Pocketpair #GamingNews
